There's no Marrow Agrisupply account folder, so there's no CRM or profile record to check either.
- **Closest lead:** the 9 June escalation in #central-team only mentions "store ops" at Marrow, with no person named. Hollis took setup and support (ticket PD-4821) and Pree took the calls with store ops, so I suggested he ask one of them.

I didn't use `search_messages` or read any channel he isn't in.
